text: The Civic Appointments Committee will select candidates to interview for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend one candidate for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board: TPL2-734; TPL2-755; TPL2-780; and TPL2-816. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board.
